text:
emily: Deploybot just alerted on a rollout for v3.9.2 — Canary error spike in apac, error_rate 1.2% (>0.5%) and some 504s. Autopilot suggests auto-revert. Change window still open for ~35m. Thoughts? :eyes:
deploybot: [AUTOMATED] Canary checks: error_rate=1.2% (threshold 0.5%), p95_latency=1600ms (threshold 1200ms). Suggested action: auto-revert to v3.9.1. To approve auto action run `/deploy revert --auto v3.9.1`
raj: seeing increased 504s in apac-canary; likely retry amplification from new backoff defaults in the client lib. If we auto-revert we avoid more customer impact but we'll lose a forensic snapshot.
emily: agree we should do manual rollback to capture artifacts and coordinate comms. Plan: 1) disable auto-revert (ops-run) 2) pin routing to v3.9.1 (ops-run) 3) take snapshots + profile 4) route 25% back for 8m, monitor 5) full cutover if stable. pm, support — can you prep customer note?
ops-run: disabling auto-revert now, latch id L-579123. Will not perform automated actions until explicit lead `/deploy revert` or manual ops instruction.
raj: I'll run profiler and collect logs: `./bin/trace-collector --app canary --since 15m -o /tmp/snap-579123.tar.gz`
pm: drafting comm: "We're rolling back the canary for v3.9.2 in APAC due to elevated gateway 504s. No customer downtime expected. Investigating client backoff changes and will share findings." Will post to #customer-comms when ready.
support: flagging two customers on APAC who reported failures; i'll DM and let them know a rollback is planned.
emily: ops-run, please apply routing pin with TTL 2h and return lock id. Raj, paste artifact locations here when done.
ops-run: applied pin to v3.9.1, lock r-pin-88, TTL=2h. Standing by to shift traffic slices on emily's go.
raj: snapshot uploaded to gs://redwood-dumps/snap-579123.tar.gz. Preliminary flamegraph shows thread saturation in client retry handler.
emily: initiating 25% route back now. Monitor p95 and errors for 8m.
ops-run: 25% traffic switched at 5791230022. Monitoring.
raj: at 25% slice p95=980ms, error_rate=0.15%, 504s dropped to baseline. Looks stable.
emily: okay proceed to 100% after 8m if metrics hold. PM and support, please finalize the comm — I'll send external note and update release notes to show rollback and follow-up investigation.
pm: posted draft to #customer-comms and updated release-notes draft: https://docs.redwood/rel-notes/drafts/v3.9.2-rollback. Also adding link to artifact bucket.
support: customers DM'd, no escalations so far.
emily: after 8m metrics stable, ops-run please remove pin and cutover to v3.9.1 100%.
ops-run: pin removed and cutover to v3.9.1 at 5791230040. Traffic at 100%, autoscaler re-enabled.
raj: post-cutover checks look good. Opening postmortem PM-579123 for research to investigate client backoff defaults and retry amplification.
emily: thanks team. We'll archive artifacts, notify sales, and circle back in the postmortem with remediation and plan to harden rollout flags for client defaults. Thread closed once PM created. :white_check_mark:
